data.title: Consider a cast-in boss instead of a bolted bracket on the housing cover
data.description: The housing cover bolts to the float arm through a separate bracket and 4x M8 fasteners. Casting the boss into the cover would remove the bracket, cut ~40 seconds of assembly per unit and delete two purchased parts.
data._display: Consider a cast-in boss instead of a bolted bracket on the housing cover

data.title: Missing GD&T on bearing bore
data.description: Float pivot bore Ø25mm has no cylindricity or true position callout. Required per ASME Y14.5. Recommend: cylindricity 0.015mm, TP ∅0.05mm to datum A.

data.title: Wall thickness below minimum at bearing pocket
data.description: Wall section near the bearing pocket seal groove is 4.1mm — below the 5.0mm minimum for A356 sand casting at this section length. Risk of misrun and shrink porosity. Increase to minimum 6.0mm.
data._display: Wall thickness below minimum at bearing pocket

data.title: Sharp inside corner on mounting flange — stress riser
data.description: R0.5mm inside corner at mounting flange will cause stress concentration under vibration. Recommend minimum R2mm fillet per company DFM standard DS-2024-001.
data._display: Sharp inside corner on mounting flange — stress riser
